grouping_contract.full_dataset: one unit containing every admitted session
grouping_contract.groups_of_8: non-overlapping consecutive chunks of exactly eight admitted sessions
grouping_contract.receiver_leakage_policy: all receivers, visits and tracks from a session remain in its unit
grouping_contract.remainder_policy: record separately; never label a partial chunk as an 8-scan unit
grouping_contract.single_scans: one admitted whole session per unit
